definition_zh: 紧固螺栓连接约束或预紧效果降低的损伤状态。
usage_note: 本文将其作为扣件状态类别，并通过参数变化构造模拟标签。
usage_overview: 在钢轨扣件振动损伤检测模型中，作为待识别的扣件状态类别，通过降低扣件刚度和阻尼等参数等效模拟，并据此构造模拟状态标签。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Concretely, three categories of fastener states, i.e. intact condition, bolt loosening and rail pad ageing, are defined.

Taking this into account, this paper aims at developing an ABA-based detection method to identify the invisible damages of the rail fastener generally shown in the forms of bolt loosening and rail pad ageing.
